answer: Sybil resistance by path-diverse relay quorums. Votes count only when they arrive through distinct karst canyon relays, physical chokepoints audited from a shared atlas of fiber routes. One identity, one relay path; the atlas forbids two identities from sharing a canyon entry. To spawn N fakes an attacker must lease N separate canyon crossings, each paying the full crossing fee set by its relay's real bandwidth cost, no bulk discount, so cost scales linearly with N while an honest agent pays one crossing once.
